title: Red Sox’ Willson Contreras leaves game after scary HBP vs. Dodgers
author: Kaley Brown
bullets: Red Sox' Willson Contreras was hit in the helmet by a 95 MPH pitch from Dodgers' Will Klein.
Contreras initially stayed in the game but was replaced defensively in the next half-inning.
Contreras leads the Red Sox in multiple offensive categories including batting average and home runs this season.

title: After Patriots coaching stint, DeAndre Hopkins joins Georgia Tech staff
author: Kaley Brown
bullets: DeAndre Hopkins joins Georgia Tech as assistant wide receivers coach after New England Patriots training camp stint.
Hopkins, 34, considered continuing his NFL career but chose coaching, valued by Georgia Tech for his experience and leadership.
Former Patriots player Vinnie Sunseri also on Georgia Tech staff; the program faces Boston College on October 24.

title: Could Efton Chism and Kyle Williams both make the Patriots 53-man roster?
author: Colin McCarthy
bullets: Efton Chism and Kyle Williams are vying for a spot on the Patriots' 53-man roster during training camp.
New England's receiver group, including Romeo Doubs and Kayshon Boutte, is performing well but may require difficult roster decisions.
DeMario Douglas leads the slot receiver battle, closely followed by Chism and Williams during the Patriots' preseason.

title: Reports: OF George Springer interested in trade to Red Sox, team eyeing INF Xavier Edwards
author: Kaley Brown
bullets: Red Sox show interest in George Springer; Springer open to trade from Blue Jays with no trade block to Boston.
Red Sox pursuing Miami's Xavier Edwards as infield help amid Curtis Mead's injury; Edwards can play shortstop or second base.
Springer, a four-time All-Star, is earning $24.1 million; Edwards is set for arbitration in 2027.

title: 5 must-watch movies & TV shows streaming right now
author: Kevin Slane
bullets: 'The Devil Wears Prada 2' featuring Meryl Streep and Anne Hathaway is now available on Hulu.
'The Drama,' filmed in Boston with Zendaya and Robert Pattinson, is streaming on HBO Max.
'Furious' Season 1, a series about an FBI agent and a serial killer, is available on Hulu.

title: Here’s how home, away broadcasts reacted to Jarren Duran’s on-field flare-up
author: Kaley Brown
bullets: Jarren Duran's outburst during a 3-3 tie went viral, reportedly directed at teammate Willson Contreras or coach Chad Epperson.
Local and opposing team broadcasts criticized Duran, with NESN and WEEI commentators expressing confusion and disapproval over his actions.
Boston Red Sox are open to trading Duran before the MLB trade deadline despite a recent 15-game winning streak bringing them into playoff contention.

title: Drake Maye on building chemistry with A.J. Brown: ‘I am not going to shy away from him.’
author: Khari A. Thompson
bullets: Drake Maye and A.J. Brown have built a strong connection during New England Patriots training camp, showcasing their chemistry in recent practices.
Maye consistently targeted Brown, completing multiple passes during camp drills, indicating growing trust and understanding between the two players.
Maye emphasizes the importance of communication and collaboration with Brown to enhance their on-field performance and gain competitive edge.

title: Drake Maye, A.J. Brown heat up and other takeaways from Day 6 of Patriots training camp
author: Conor Ryan
bullets: Drake Maye showed strong performance in Patriots' padded practice, completing 18-of-19 passes during team drills.
A.J. Brown is improving his connection with Maye, catching several passes in drills during Patriots training camp.
Rookie tight end Eli Raridon continues to impress, securing a touchdown from Maye during 7-on-7 drills.

title: Massachusetts falls out of top 10 in best state rankings by U.S. News & World Report
author: Annie Jonas
bullets: Massachusetts ranked 11th in U.S. News & World Report's 2026 Best States rankings, dropping from 9th position in 2025.
The state maintained its high healthcare performance, ranking second overall, but experienced declines in education and opportunity.
Massachusetts scored poorly in fiscal stability ranking 39th, and in infrastructure ranking 38th, impacting its overall standings.

title: Massachusetts loses two IHOP restaurants
author: Beth Treffeisen
bullets: IHOP closed its Cambridge and Hyannis locations, leaving 19 other locations operational in Massachusetts.
The Hyannis IHOP served as a late-night dining spot for over 50 years, becoming a local fixture.
The closures are possibly due to reduced foot traffic or lease issues, according to IHOP franchisee Mark Justice.
